messages.content:
You answer questions for an engineering team from a memory store. The user message holds the memory you may use, then the question.
Rules:
- Answer only from the memory provided. Do not use outside knowledge and do not guess.
- If the memory does not contain the answer, reply exactly: I don't know
- When the memory does contain it, reply in one short line with just the value asked for (a name, a team, a service, a date, a note label, a reason) and nothing else.
- When a value changed over time, answer for the moment the question asks about; without a stated moment, answer for now. Today is 2026-06-30.
- Memory entries carry the date they were recorded. Treat a later entry as superseding an earlier one on the same subject.

Memory:
- The indexer is pinned to OpenSearch 2.11 until the full reindex completes. [constraint; valid 2025-04-22 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-04-22]
- The indexer relies on the product catalog for product documents, so if the product catalog is down the indexer is down. [valid 2025-01-30 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-01-30]
- In INC-2025-023, the indexer served stale results for two days starting 2025-10-03 because a reindex job failed silently on a full disk. [valid 2025-10-07 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2025-023]
- On 2025-12-18 the Atlas team decided that the indexer will rebuild the index nightly instead of on every product catalog write, because incremental updates left stale entries behind after failed writes. [decision; valid 2025-12-18 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-12-18]
- The indexer was owned by the Atlas team from 2025-05-20, taking over from Cinder, until ownership transferred to the Boreal team on 2026-04-01. [decision; valid 2026-04-01 to now; recorded by handover/2026-04-01-search-indexer]
    earlier: The indexer is owned by the Atlas team as of 2025-05-20, taking over from Cinder. [decision; valid 2025-05-20 to 2026-04-01; recorded by handover/2025-05-20-search-indexer]
    earlier: The indexer is owned by Cinder. [valid 2025-01-17 to 2025-05-20; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-01-17-2]
- On 2026-06-09 the Dune team observed that the indexer's disk usage jumped 30 percent after the retention change. [valid 2026-06-09 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2026-06-09]
- On 2026-05-27 the Atlas team noticed that the indexer's p99 latency doubled after Tuesday's deploy and pinged the owners. [valid 2026-05-27 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2026-05-27]
- On 2026-02-10 the Boreal team noticed that the indexer's queue depth hit 50,000 after the marketing send and pinged the owners. [valid 2026-02-10 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2026-02-10-2]
- As of 2026-04-01, the pager for the indexer rings the Boreal team, not the Atlas team. [valid 2026-04-01 to now; recorded by handover/2026-04-01-search-indexer]
- As of 2025-10-07, reindex jobs will page on failure. [decision; valid 2025-10-07 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2025-023]
- On 2026-04-01, ownership of the indexer transferred from the Atlas team to the Boreal team. [valid 2026-04-01 to now; recorded by handover/2026-04-01-search-indexer]
- On 2026-06-04 the Boreal team noticed that the product catalog's memory use grew steadily for a week after the cache change and pinged the owners. [valid 2026-06-04 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2026-06-04]
- On 2026-03-20 the Boreal team noticed that the product catalog's disk usage jumped 30 percent after the retention change. [valid 2026-03-20 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2026-03-20-2]
- The root cause of INC-2025-011 was an index missing after the schema migration. [valid 2025-05-30 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2025-011]
- The product catalog is owned by the Atlas team as of 2025-12-19, having moved from Cinder. [decision; valid 2025-12-19 to now; recorded by handover/2025-12-19-catalog]
    earlier: Cinder owns the product catalog. [valid 2025-01-17 to 2025-12-19; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-01-17]
- On 2026-02-16 the Dune team noticed that the product catalog's request volume halved after the client rollout and pinged the owners. [valid 2026-02-16 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2026-02-16]
- On 2025-02-21 the Boreal team noticed that the ledger service's memory use had grown steadily for a week after the cache change. [valid 2025-02-21 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-02-21-2]
- As of 2025-10-13, the pager for the ledger service rings Cinder instead of the Atlas team. [valid 2025-10-13 to now; recorded by handover/2025-10-13-ledger]
- On 2026-04-16 the Atlas team noticed that the ledger service's disk usage jumped 30 percent following the retention change and flagged it because it is not their service. [valid 2026-04-16 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2026-04-16]
- As of 2025-06-24, the reporting service still relies on the ledger service. [valid 2025-06-24 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2025-06-24]
